description_en: Queries the HTTP/2.0 fingerprint information of a website
description_zh: 查询网站的HTTP 2.0 指纹信息
name: DescribeDomainH2Fingerprint

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query the domain names of all websites protected by Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的网站业务的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The time must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The time must be on the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The source of the queried data. Valid values:
block: statistics on blocked access sources.
visit: statistics on normal access sources
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的来源。取值：
block：表示被拦截的访问来源统计。
visit：表示正常访问来源统计
parameters.name: query_type

DomainH2Fp.description_en: The list of the top N HTTP/2.0 fingerprints for the domain name
DomainH2Fp.description_zh: 域名Top N HTTP2.0 指纹列表

Domain.description_en: The domain name of the website

Pv.description_en: The number of times the domain name matched the HTTP/2.0 fingerprint
Pv.description_zh: 域名匹配HTTP2.0 指纹次数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
